evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams supports records up to 10 mebibytes (MiBs). This capability is recommended for processing intermittent data payloads that exceed the default 1 MiB record size limit. The default maximum record size for existing, and newly created streams is set to 1 MiB.
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports record sizes up to 10MiB, a tenfold increase from the previous 1MiB limit.
To start using large records in your stream, update your stream's maximum record size limit.
